messages:
sam: Hey team, quick check. CloudVendorY just confirmed staggered delivery: 6 racks next Wed, remaining 4 racks two weeks later. We requested 40 A100s total but can accept phased attach. Want to avoid a big quota spike. Thoughts on doing phased Dedicated pool attach?

leila: Phased attach sounds good. We can create the Dedicated config now and apply the first tranche. Keep it non-provisioned for the backfill tranche until finance signs off.

marco: Agree. Two implementation notes: 1) the quota system counts allocated GPUs only when provision=true. 2) we should reserve tenant slots in the pool ACLs ahead of time so demo teams don't claim them.

tara: Can we automate the second attach with a small job? e.g., when vendor webhook shows rack "deployed", run infra job to flip provision for that tranche. Saves manual flipping.

sam: Good idea. We have vendor webhook endpoint; can add a small lambda to call infra pipeline. Might need an allowlist for the webhook signature though.

zhi: I'll take a look at the webhook -> infra hook. I can write a tiny verifier and a pipeline trigger. ETA EOD tomorrow.

procure-bot: PO status: Invoice received, under review by finance. Hold flag set. (metadata: PO#12345)

leila: Heads-up: finance requested line-item clarification on shipping terms. That may delay provisioning by ~48-72h after initial rack arrival. Recommend landing infra PR with provision=false.

sam: PR #4582 updates dedicated pool module and adds ACLs + attach script. CI failed lint; small style issues. I can fix if folks are fine with landing with provision=false.

marco: Please address lint in PR. Also add a note in PR description about phased attach and the webhook plan. That helps ops later.

tara: If you want me to run the smoke/failure scenarios after first attach I can do it. Also confirm which stack (staging vs prod) we test on.

sam: We'll test on staging first. Tara, please include a degraded fallback test (route requests to hosted variant) in the runbook.

zhi: Work item: implement webhook verifier + terraform trigger (zzi/WIP). I will open a draft PR and assign sam for infra details.

leila: Action items:
- sam: fix lint + update PR description with phased attach + runbook
- zhi: draft webhook verifier PR and pipeline trigger
- marco: coordinate PO line-item clarification with procurement
- tara: prepare smoke test checklist for staging -> prod cutover

marco: Procurement updated PO note to vendor, should get clarification within 24h. will post when received.

sam: thanks. landing plan: merge with provision=false once lint fixed, then automate first attach when we have rack live + finance clear. I'll post progress here. :thumbsup:
